title: Play, browse, and compare models with fewer clicks
summary:
A buzzing day for getting from model discovery to working output: direct Play links, a new 4K video model, healthier community catalogs, and a Quest scoreboard.

Supported models now include a Try in Play action that opens a correctly configured Play session directly from the listing. Pixel Forge also joined the community app catalog as a focused image studio for comparing Flux, Dreamshaper, Klein, GPT Image 2, Zimage, and Nanobanana at chosen dimensions.

Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash is now available for short text- or keyframe-driven videos with synchronized audio, vertical or widescreen output, and resolutions up to 4K. When a request cannot complete, Gemini Omni now returns useful provider and moderation details instead of the traditional mysterious 502 fog.

The app catalog now has visual previews across all 835 active apps, backed by weekly screenshot keepalives, while DemoWeaver and Automated Video App joined the build and video ecosystem. New public models and endpoint agents also get a clear scheduled publication window, shown directly in My Models.

highlights.title: Every model gets a playground
highlights.text: Open any supported Image, Text, Audio, or Video model directly in a preconfigured [Play session](https://pollinations.ai/play).

highlights.title: The quest garden has rankings
highlights.text: The Community page now shows the top Quest contributors, completed quests, and Pollen earned. Useful motivation, mildly dangerous for your sleep schedule.

highlights.title: Two frames, then cinema
highlights.text: Generate 3–10 second, audio-synced video clips with `google/gemini-omni-1.1-flash`: text or two keyframes in, 360p to 4K video out. [Check the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Pixels enter the forge
highlights.text: Pixel Forge is a focused image studio for comparing Flux, Dreamshaper, Klein, GPT Image 2, Zimage, and Nanobanana at the dimensions you choose. [Try it](https://b3b41020.github.io/pixel-forge)
